n = int(input())
grid = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
MOD = 1000000007
total_sum = 0

for subset_mask in range(1 << n):
    product_value = 1
    for col_idx in range(n):
        val = 1
        for row_idx in range(n):
            if subset_mask & (1 << row_idx):
                val = (val * grid[row_idx][col_idx]) % MOD
            else:
                val = (val * (MOD + 1 - grid[row_idx][col_idx]) % MOD) % MOD
        product_value = (product_value * val) % MOD
    total_sum = (total_sum + product_value) % MOD

print(total_sum)
